photo.alt: The old city of Muscat with its white buildings below the mountains

facts: About 1.72 million people in the Muscat Governorate (2022)
On the Gulf of Oman, below the Hajar Mountains
worth_knowing: Known since the early 1st century CE as a leading port for trade between the west and the east. The water off the coast runs deep, forming two natural harbours, at Muttrah and Muscat.
